notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
Thornbite Staff attached to Adun.
Adun does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{R}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Adun triggers, untapping Adun.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power..
Activate Adun by paying {B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
